description:

name: LA-1
description:
## Description

"A stereo amplifier developed to satisfy 4conditions of PSPM (pitch feeling, separation, perspective and musical fidelity).The circuit design was done by Toshio Endo, an audio specialist who created the sound of the clear ball speaker.The LA-1consists of a simple circuit, and the Power is moderately controlled to enhance sound quality and the best parts are selected for overall sound balance.For example, a capacitor using 1% class precision tantalum resistor, conductive plastic volume control, and OFC lead wire is used, and a characteristic ring core transformer and high-voltage fast recovery diode are used for the power supply.Non-magnetic materials are used throughout the chassis and small parts to prevent electromagnetic induction as much as possible.The power device uses LM1875T manufactured by National Semiconductor.It is designed to match with a clear ball speaker, but the playback of other speakers is also considered."
